name: Being Lukewarm
overview: Scripture warns against spiritual complacency, emphasizing that mere profession without obedience is insufficient for entering God's kingdom, as Jesus states that only those who do the Father's will will enter (Matthew 7:21). Believers are called to actively live and walk in the Spirit (Galatians 5:25) and to be doers of the Word rather than merely hearers, avoiding self-deception (James 1:22). The danger of being lukewarm is highlighted in Revelation 3:15, where God expresses a preference for believers to be either fully committed or not at all, rather than indifferent. Furthermore, friendship with the world is identified as enmity with God, underscoring the call to wholehearted devotion (James 4:4).
